releases.name: AbyssME 0.8.0 Beta 1
releases.body:
AbyssME now brings 24 platforms together on ARM64. The new platform gallery lets you pick a device and browse its games. Turn on **Show platforms without games** to find a new system, install its firmware if needed, and add your first game.

Alongside Java ME, Mophun, Symbian and N-Gage, the ARM64 edition includes WIPI / SKVM, Dingoo A320, Gemei A330, Aquaplus P/ECE, Watara Supervision, Mega Duck, Cybiko, Flash Lite, Gamate, Palm OS, Palm webOS, Firefox OS, KaiOS, Atari Portfolio, early iPhone OS, Arduboy / FX, Gamebuino Classic, Pokitto, original Thumby and ESPboy. The ARMv7 edition includes Java ME and Mophun.

**Download** the standard APK for ARM64 or the APK marked **armv7** for a 32-bit ARM device. Both require Android 10 or later. Install over the previous official APK to keep your games and saves. Supply your own games and system files.

[Setup guide](https://abysstail.art/guides/abyssme-setup.html) · [Source and build instructions](https://github.com/EriArk/JavaEmulator/blob/v0.8.0-beta.1/docs/releases/v0.8.0-beta.1.md)

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.body:
It is my pleasure to announce a new version of Hades!

There's a ton of new and exciting features on this one, I'm happy it's finally landing in your hands 😁. 

Among others, this release provides:

## **Highlights**:
- **Cheat code support**:  with all three major cheat devices: GameShark, CodeBreaker and Pro Action Replay v3 (PARv3)
- **xBRZ scaling filter**, for sharp, smooth visuals at high resolutions
- **Idle loop elimination**, to boost the performances of some of your favorite games

## **Emulation**:
- **ROM Mirroring support**, which fixes a bunch of input issues in the Classic NES Series games
- **OBJ rendering cycle limits**: sprites now have a per-scanline rendering budget, like the real PPU
- **PSG channels 2 and 3** are now resampled correctly each time their frequency changes
- **New color correction profiles** based on the work of Pokefan531 and Hunterk

## **Performance**:
- The scheduler now uses a **min-heap** to find the next event faster, giving a significant performance boost
- **Link-time optimizations (LTO)** are now enabled by default for release builds
- Fixed a performance issue when a file dialog was open

## **Interface**:

## Trierarch 0.3.0 (2026-04-04)

### Added
- **In-app terminal** (Termux-style) for the proot shell, with bundled monospace fonts, **Appearance**, and packaged font licenses.
- **Multi-session terminal:** per-session PTY and tabs from the orb (switch / add / remove); sessions use ids **1, 2, …**.
- **Display on session 0:** startup script runs on a dedicated shell so the desktop and terminal tabs no longer share one PTY.

### Changed
- **Terminal** screen respects **status bar** and **soft keyboard** insets.
- **Pointer:** separate scroll scaling for **physical wheel** vs **two-finger** gestures; **faster** touchpad cursor (finger × 2.5).
- **Glass/orb UI:** menus and settings sheets **size to the window**; orb grouped under **Common**, **Desktop**, **Terminal**.

### Fixed
- **Touchpad two-finger (Wayland):** avoid stray **left-button** / stuck behavior when the second finger cancels hold-drag timing, and keep **simulated touchpad** state correct after **two-finger tap → right click**.
- **View Settings (Wayland output):** **Scale** had no effect and **Resolution** vs **Scale** did not behave distinctly (only changing resolution drove UI size).

releases.body:
## 1.0.3 社区发布

本版整合已测试的图形、声音和缓存优化，提供 Android ARM64 安装包与社区应用包。游戏数据由使用者自行准备，应用通过 ARM64 原生执行、HLE 服务桥接及 NVN → Vulkan 兼容层运行。

## 更新内容

- 请求低延迟音频输出，并处理设备拒绝请求时的回退。RG477M 同场景计入应用排队后的时间戳推算播放等待，旧模式约 215 毫秒，本版运行层两轮约 101、137 毫秒。
- 缓存原生模块的分配器导出位置，改进纹理描述符 ID 查找，缩小已证明写回范围的缓存维护。
- 失效描述符缓存的 CPU 元数据按每帧最多 512 项分批清理，清理安排在 GPU 提交和限帧等待之间。
- 保留可编辑虚拟手柄、掌机原生键位与游戏内存档功能。金手指功能计划后续加入。

## 机型与实测范围

- 全部设备采用底座模式，目标帧率为 30。高端高分辨率机型选择原生底座渲染档位，RG477M 使用 800×450 内部三维渲染档位。
- RG477M 的花叶位置测试了 2400 个真实移动帧间隔，实际显示约 29.20 帧，最长显示间隔约 99 毫秒。对照版本同点约 28.44 帧，最长约 116 毫秒。本版发布包的原生库与该次测量使用的原生库逐字节一致。
- 高通、天玑设备分档与厂商条件通过组件回归，包含荣耀 SM8635 / Adreno 735 配置。荣耀平板的本版安装与真实游戏回归等待用户重新连接 USB，其他机型需要逐机验证。
- 图形测试 94 项，93 项通过，1 项缺少私有输入而跳过。运行时 10 项、JNI 分档 4 项及 Java 机型分档合约通过。

## 已知限制

全场景稳定 30 帧尚未完成，复杂城镇、过图与长时间运行仍可能卡顿。对白口型及完整过场的物理音画同步仍待验证。正式发布版本号表示这一阶段的可下载构建，兼容范围以实测记录为准。

## 安装与校验

安装附件 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-arm64.apk`，或解压 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-community.zip` 获取应用、安装说明、版权说明及第三方许可证。准备同版本 v1.0.7 的 NSO、RomFS 与转换后的着色器，目录与权限操作见附件 `install-guide.zh-CN.md`。升级前请备份个人存档。

附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 与 `release-manifest.json` 提供完整性及来源记录。

## 交流群与资源说明

抖音搜索 ID `Cetto`（或搜索 `樱木`），进入主页加入交流群。群公告提供部署说明与资源配置指引。使用者应确保自行提供的数据具有相应使用权，并支持正版游戏。

本版本为 `1.0.2-preview` 社区预览版，重点优化了掌机/手持设备的底座模式适配策略、图形渲染流水线及 CPU/GPU 调度效率。

- **渲染调度与流水线优化**：优化间接绘制调度流程，精简不必要的 CPU 同步等待，保留精准的 GPU 资源生命周期检查，降低图形提交开销。

---

- **已知限制**：当前属于预览测试阶段，尚未达到全场景稳定 30 FPS，相关性能与管线优化仍在持续推进中。

---

- 欢迎在群内交流各机型实机运行反馈、按键映射体验与性能表现。

---

## 📦 安装与数据要求

1. 附件提供 ARM64 安装包（`.apk`）、完整社区包（`.zip`）及对应校验文件。
2. 运行必须配合 **《空之轨迹 the 1st》v1.0.7 原版游戏数据**（NSO 主程序、RomFS 及转换后的着色器需保持版本完全一致）。

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。
- Mali 默认使用原游戏 960×540 三维渲染档位，目标 30 帧。采用缓存读回和两项着色器等价整理，事件延迟发布和大缓冲写跟踪默认关闭。用户已确认这一配置天空无闪烁。
- 天玑 MT68/MT69 默认保留原游戏分配器空指针判断，避免地址位判断破坏分配器状态。
- 虚拟手柄参照同作者 FFRS 项目，支持显示切换、长按编辑、拖动布局、大小与透明度保存。保留原游戏存档。金手指计划后续加入。
- 桌面应用图标采用自有几何山形图案。版本号由本轮整理设为 1.0.1-preview，code 2。

## 实测与已知问题

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

当前复杂户外与城镇仍有明显掉帧，尚未达到稳定 30 帧。无闪烁配置的户外采样约 21～25 帧，复杂城镇约 10～20 帧，首次加载和过图仍可能停顿。曾接近 30 帧的事件延迟实验会出现天空条纹，因此发布配置关闭该实验。完整游戏流程与长时间稳定性仍待验证。

其他天玑机型仍待逐机实测。荣耀平板沿用原有设备分支，本轮按用户要求暂停荣耀真机回归。

## 下载和安装

直接安装 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-arm64.apk`。社区转发可使用 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-community.zip`，其中包含 APK、安装说明、版权与免责说明、完整第三方许可和构建清单。使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验下载内容。

应用包名 `org.snk.the1st.gamewindow`，arm64-v8a，当前为预览调试签名包。覆盖安装前请备份自己的原游戏存档，签名不匹配时先核实旧包来源。

使用者自行准备合法取得并完整合并的 v1.0.7 数据，目录内应包含四个 NSO、RomFS 与配套转换着色器。具体目录与按键操作见随包《安装与使用》。

releases.name: 3.0.6 - November 18, 2026

EN-US

Test build for issue #1422: with "Reuse compiled shaders from disk" on, the loading screen stood still at 100%. The game was waiting for the shader cache to be written to disk without redrawing the screen. The screen now counts those writes, and Esc or Circle ends the wait.

How to help:
- Extract the zip to a new folder
- From your current SpartanPort folder (the one with SpartanPort.exe), copy the `user` folder and the files `settings.json` and `spartanport.ini` into the new `spartanport-windows` folder, so the game starts from the same shader cache
- Open SpartanPort.exe in the new folder, keep "Reuse compiled shaders from disk" on and start the game
- After the count reaches the end it starts again for the cache writes, then "Preparing pipelines" runs for a few minutes
- Tell us on issue #1422:
  - Whether the count keeps moving and the game opens
  - Whether a second start goes straight into the game
  - Attach `user/last_run.log` from the new folder

Built on a development PC from commit c91ad6f, because GitHub Actions is off for the repository at the moment. Not a final release.

# IZPSX emulator 0.5.3

IZPSX runs PlayStation games on Nintendo Switch 2 through [IZ2S](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZ2S-Platform).

## Install

### Through IZ2S App library

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza).
2. In IZ2S, open **App library**, import the `.iza` file, and install it to the Switch 2 SD card. IZ2S installs the emulator in `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`. The installer includes the launcher, engine, shaders, font, and interface assets.

### Directly to the SD card

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip).
2. Extract the ZIP to the root of the Switch 2 SD card so `iz2s/` sits at the top level. The archive includes the emulator files and empty `bios/`, `games/`, and `saves/` folders under `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`.

Preserve your BIOS, games, memory cards, and settings when updating.

## BIOS and games

| File | SD card path |
| --- | --- |
| Your own PlayStation BIOS, exactly **512 KiB (524,288 bytes)** | `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/bios/bios.bin` |

## What's new

- **The app warns you when a controller's battery runs low.** You get a notification naming the player and controller, and the controller beeps when it reaches your chosen level (10% by default, with an optional earlier warning). Both are switches in Settings.
- **The app tells you when a controller disconnects.** The notification names the player and says if the battery ran out, and it clears when the controller reconnects. You can turn it off in Settings.
- **The battery percentage is accurate all the way down.** It comes from a measured full discharge of a Joy-Con 2 pair, so 50% means half your play time is left, and a brief dip during rumble doesn't change it.
- **The NSO GameCube controller rumbles.** Game rumble now reaches its motor.

Download `joycon2android-3.2.0.apk` below and install it over your existing copy. See the [README](https://github.com/JoeGeC/joycon2android#setup-guide) for the full setup guide.

releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* Better ZIP file compatibility in iOS
* Added keyboard shortcuts for the VRAM and Memory Viewers in the Cocoa frontends
  * VRAM Viewer tabs can be switched using ^1 - ^4
* `0x` can now be used an an alternative hexadecimal prefix in the debugger and Memory Viewer

## Accuracy Improvements/Fixes
* More accurate emulation of invalid MLT_REQ SGB commands
* Fixed a bug where certain Game Boy Printer margin configurations were not emulated correctly
* When emulating an RTC cartridge in Sync-to-Host mode, the RTC will now correctly halt if instructed by the ROM
* Improved Game Boy Printer accuracy and timings
* More realistic IR emulation, fixes IR features in certain games
* Improved DAC emulation, especially on pre-GBC models
* Improved LFSR stepping on pre-GBC models

releases.name: XRecomp v0.19.0
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.19.0

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

A second Xbox 360 performance night, measured headless on Warhammer: Battle March. Frames and save states are byte
identical to 0.18.0, except where a change is opt-in or per title (below).

- **Guest CPU**: `MmQueryStatistics` keeps a page count instead of scanning (it was half of the boot's host CPU). The
  VMX helpers work on 16- and 8-bit lanes, use the compiler's vector extensions and are inlined. Host CPU: the boot
  is 3× faster and in-game play 1.8× (141 → 79 ms of guest time per swap). The scheduler turn is cheaper and makes
  the same decisions. Prepare is not slower: the VMX-heavy files compile 27–41 % faster with NDK clang.
- **Renderer**: 16-bit resolve formats take the fast path, and the stencil is read back in 2 passes instead of 8.
  Tiled addressing is worked out per tile row, texture rows are read 16 bytes at a time, texture memory is hashed in
  8 lanes and packed vertex formats use tables. Renderer CPU per swap is about half of 0.18.0's.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.6.0
releases.body:
This one is mostly about what happens *under* the 3D. The emulator itself got a lot better.

## New

**Accuracy: 147 of 147 on AccuracyCoin.** 0.5.0 passed 128. Zaxnes was also compared cycle by cycle with a transistor-level simulation of the NES chips (421,901 CPU cycles, DMA included), and the timing matched. Where the two still differ, tests made on real consoles side with Zaxnes.

**Over 400 mappers.** Up from 144. That includes the **Famicom Disk System**, the **VS. System** with its cabinet buttons, and newer boards like the Rainbow.

**A fast core.** It skips work the screen doesn't need, but gives the same results as the accurate core. We checked that frame by frame on 320 ROMs. Handhelds use it by default.

**New options window.** One slider goes from *Fastest* to *Most faithful* and sets everything that costs speed. A simple mode shows only what most people need, and an advanced mode shows everything. It works the same on the PC and on the console screen.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.5.0
releases.body:
Zaxnes is an independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo.

## Highlights

**3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 compatibility.** Profiles from 3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 import and play, with what the new versions brought: reflections, bend, the new camera and Lua features.

**A real NES emulator, not just a gimmick.** Mapper support goes from 85 to 144, and AccuracyCoin from 89 to 128 tests out of 147. More accuracy work is coming in the next releases.

**New widescreen hacks: Kirby's Adventure and Faxanadu.** Every regional version of each. Faxanadu already has its 3D profile in this release; Kirby's is on the way.

**Smooth scrolling at 120 Hz (experimental).** On a 120 Hz screen, the playfield is drawn between two emulated frames, from the run-ahead.

**RetroArch shaders.** Slang shaders (through librashader) on the Vulkan / DirectX 12 renderer: CRT, scanlines, LCD, Mega Bezel TV frames. A pack of presets is built in, separately for 2D and 3D. Available on Android too.

**Editor mode for 3D profiles (work in progress).** An AI-assisted editor: it gives an AI agent a harness through a local MCP server, and a prompt ready to copy and paste. Expect more on it in the next release.

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.7...v5.1.8

releases.body:
# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

releases.name: v0.4.10

Faster starts with mods installed, plus housekeeping for the releases themselves. Everything from [0.4.9](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.9) is included.

## Mods

- **Mods no longer slow down every start.** The port used to read every file of every mod in `mods` at each start to check it, which took seconds with big mods. It now remembers those checks and only reads a file again when its size or date changes. The first start after installing or updating a mod takes as long as before; the next ones skip that work.

## Android

- The APK's internal version number jumps from 39 to 4010. It still installs over the old one; nothing to do on your side.

## Install / update

Windows: download `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64.zip` and copy the **contents** of its `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64` folder into your game folder. Your `gow2.toml` and saves are kept.

releases.name: v0.4.9
releases.body:
Achievement names in Cyrillic, Korean and Chinese, a saving message that no longer mentions a console, better Mali detection on Android, Esc going back in menus, and the first community contributions, all from optimistic-blip. Everything from [0.4.8](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.8) is included.

## Fixes

- **Achievement names in every language (#54).** The achievement pop-up and the achievement list (F7) are drawn by the port with a small Latin-only font, so Russian, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Korean and Chinese names showed up as `?????`. That font now gets Cyrillic and the Central European letters from a system font (Segoe UI on Windows, Roboto on Android), plus Korean or Traditional Chinese glyphs when the game runs in one of those languages.
- **"Please don't turn off your PC" (#64).** The checkpoint message said "console". It now says PC in all 12 languages, and "device" on Android. The text is changed at run time like the port's other text edits; the game folder is not touched. The idea, and a tool for changing the file itself, came from optimistic-blip.

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
Co-op settings no longer have to match between friends, players 3 and up get their own Centaur in the tank chapter, and the native renderer stops smearing textures on AMD cards. Everything from [0.4.7](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.7) is included.

## Co-op

- **The host's settings apply to everyone in that campaign.** Before, a friend whose co-op settings differed from the host's (player count, extra players ending the game, and so on) did not see the campaign at all. Now only the release has to match: friends see the host's campaign whatever their own `gow2_coop_players` and co-op options say, and the host's settings decide how that campaign plays. Campaigns from a different release still stay hidden, and since 0.4.8 that check covers two-player games too.
- **One Centaur per player in the tank chapter.** When Marcus drives the Centaur, every player 3 and up gets a tank of their own next to him instead of hanging off his. If someone leaves their tank, dies, or falls too far behind, they get a new one next to Marcus; the extra tanks go away when the tank section ends. `gow2_coop_tanks = false` turns it off.

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
Phones get new defaults that run smoother and cooler, voices on Android should come through again, and every platform gets a Render scale option. Everything from [0.4.6](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.6) is included.

## Android

- **Frame rate unlocked with a 45 fps limit, by default.** Uncapped, the phone's GPU runs at full load until the phone lowers its clock as it heats up; the limit keeps headroom. The limit drops to the nearest rate that divides your screen's refresh, so every frame lasts the same: 40 fps on a 120 Hz screen (Galaxy S24/S25), 45 at 90 Hz, 30 at 60 Hz. On an S25 Ultra frame times went from a 25/25/16.7 ms mix to an even 25 ms. You can still pick 30, 60 or no limit in Device Options > Display > Frame rate limit.
- **Render scale 75 % by default.** The 3D scene is drawn at 75 % and scaled up to the screen; on an S25 Ultra that is 14 % less GPU work per frame, with a slightly softer picture. Graphics > Render scale goes back to 100 %.
- **Snapdragon GSR for the final upscale by default**, one pass instead of FSR 1's two.

releases.name: v0.4.6
releases.body:
Insane can now be picked from the start. Everything from [0.4.5](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.5) is included; if you have not read its notes, they cover the Riftworm fix for Vulkan, GPU detection on Linux and Proton, and the co-op go-to-player-1 key.

## Every platform

- **Insane without finishing the campaign first.** The option from 0.4.5, now named **All chapters and Insane unlocked** (PC Options > Saves, on by default), also enables the Insane button in the difficulty menu, in solo Campaign and in the co-op lobby. Before, the game greyed it out until the campaign had been finished once. As with chapters, only the menu check changes: your saved progress and the Extras list of unlockables are not touched.

## Known, still open

- Lighting that looks pixelated on Linux with presets above Low, and black textures on Low on Windows (both on a Legion Go): we could not reproduce them on our PC. A screenshot and the `logs/gow2_*.log` of the run, with the chapter, help a lot.

releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

releases.name: 宝可梦传说 Z-A · Mali 零拷贝修复（3→30 FPS）
releases.body:
# 宝可梦传说 Z‑A 安卓移植 · Mali 零拷贝修复版（宿主 APK）

**这是一个“宿主”APK：只含移植运行时，不含任何游戏数据、NSO、资源或密钥。**
运行它需要你**自备自己游戏卡带/数字版的转储**，并用 [nx2android](https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android)
的 porter 生成数据包（步骤见仓库 README 的「怎么用」与「自备文件与公开性」）。

## 这版修了什么（Mali‑G925 上 3 FPS → 30 FPS）

- **根因**：MTK（MT6991）的 gralloc 给 `AHardwareBuffer` 的 native handle 有 3 个 fd，
  `fd[0]` 是 size 0 的只读元数据文件，`fd[1]` 才是 dma-buf（`st_size == 缓冲区大小`）。
  上游恒取 `fds[0]` 去 `mmap`，于是这台 Mali 上 771 MB 的 NVN 内存池**全部**退回
  “每提交整池双向 memcpy”，每帧约 375 ms——这正是帧时间的大头。
- **修法**：`ahb_buf_fd()` 按 `fstat().st_size == 池大小` 选出真正的 dma-buf fd；
  `pool_zero_copy()` 与 `vk_pool_remap_ro()` 都改用它。补丁全文：
  [`patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch`](https://github.com/Timqt/pokelegza-and/blob/main/patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch)
- **实测**（25079RPDCC，Dimensity 9400 级，Mali‑G925‑Immortalis MC12，Vulkan 1.3.278）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 零拷贝内存池 | 0 / 771 MB | **771.2 / 771.2 MB** |
| 菜单 FPS | 2–3 | **30**（游戏自身 present interval 上限） |
| 帧工作 p50 | 343 ms | **16.9 ms** |
| submit+present | 53–82 ms | 3–4.5 ms |

- 已能从语言选择一路进到开场列车场景（字幕 “Your train has arrived in Lumiose
  City!”）。当前瓶颈是 GPU 渲染（场景内约 20–25 ms，≈48 FPS 上限）。

## 使用

uncharted-android 0.3.6 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: upstream uncharted_pc 0.3.15 is merged (Uncharted 3's Load Game hang and fixes for checkpoint loads and textures), a rare crash of Uncharted 1 is fixed, Uncharted 3 gains about 1 FPS without the frame rate limit, and the GPU skinning checks its own inputs, so the rare GPU fault storms can no longer start there. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 1 could close now and then in play.** On the Retroid Pocket G2 this happened about once in three hours without the frame rate limit. A job of the game's scene update read an object whose two fields the game's other code had not filled yet. The update now waits up to about 1.6 ms for them, and if they are still empty it skips the one query that needs them; the game does not use that query's result. In a test that skipped the query every time for two minutes, the game played on unharmed.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.5 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.5 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's spider rooms run at full speed (chapter 7 ran at 10-15 FPS on the Retroid Pocket G2), a rare hang or crash of Uncharted 3 is fixed, and the app now says what is wrong with a copy of the game instead of crashing or stalling without a word. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: the rooms with the spider swarm ran at 10-15 FPS** - chapter 7, "Stay in the Light", and the swarm's return in chapter 11; on the Retroid Pocket G2 at 1280x720 the room now holds the 30 FPS limit (15.0 and 13.2 FPS before, 30.0 and 30.0 after, in two pairs of runs). One pixel shader of the swarm's material picks values from a small table by an index. The translated shader chose among all 84 of its registers at each of twelve such reads, more than the shader compiler of an Adreno has registers for, so it kept values in memory: 52 ms of GPU time a frame for a small part of the screen. The reads are now limited to the table (0.5 ms a frame); the picture is the same

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.4 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.4 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's desert chapters are drawn right - Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were stretched across the screen, on every device. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were drawn as stretched triangles** (#35). The port runs the game's many small skinning jobs in batches, and that code knew one vertex layout for each of the game's skinning shaders. From chapter 16 on the game has a second one (32-bit normals and tangents) for the models with cloth or morph targets - Drake's desert outfit, the horses' blankets and reins - and the batch wrote those vertices at the wrong places. It reads the layout of every job now and batches both; a layout it does not know goes the ordinary way and is named in the log. Thanks to @sergeymetallic, who traced the glitch to the batch, and to @tranhuythang1704 for the save the horses were checke

### What's Fixed
- **Mali GPUs (Mali-G57, Mali-G68, Mali-G615)**:

releases.name: Xenra v0.5.0
releases.body:
## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.
- Original Xbox Live through Insignia: console DNS, setup assistant and the
  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

### Original Xbox: the Performance core

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
Performance and Compatibility, matching the 360 side.

### Mali GPUs and compatibility rendering

* New features for mod developers:
  * Added optional dependency functionality, which allows mods to run different code based on the presence of another mod. See [this section of the template mod toml](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/mod.toml#L42) and [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L37) for more details.

releases.body:
> **Release candidate.** This is the first test build of 1.3.0. It adds a lot of new features, and most of them have passed automated checks so far, with them being tested by me personally but NOT all of them. Please report anything that breaks on the issue tracker, with your platform and what you were doing.

## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and the `course-*` files together.
Tracks that use the new wind or CPU aggression settings save a newer settings block that 1.2.x cannot read. Tracks that do not use them stay readable by older builds. Keep your backup if you might go back to 1.2.x.

## New: G-Diffuser Companion (Windows and Linux)

The Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux arm64 downloads now include the Companion, a separate desktop program in the `companion` folder inside your G-Diffuser folder. It builds the files G-Diffuser loads and checks every input before it builds. It never edits your settings, saves or stores.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.3 - Course Editor Hotfix
releases.body:
## Fixes
- Correct complete-course snapshot content binding so metadata-only edits do not reuse an incompatible retained snapshot.
- Handle terminal disk-write refusals without trapping Course Edit in its save wait loop.
- Fix the host editor's remaining 64-node admission ceiling. The supported total remains 127 nodes, including forks.
- Restore Content Library layout previews for supported tracks above 64 nodes.
- Adapt native load, overwrite, and delete confirmations to long filenames while keeping normal-size text and the Yes/No controls in place.
- Size the Course Edit information panel dynamically to fit the track title, length, and node count.

## Save compatibility — read before updating
Close the game and back up the complete installation save/state set before updating, not only the cartridge `.sav` file.

This release writes version-2 `.gcs` snapshots and still reads version 1. Older builds cannot read version-2 snapshots or packages that contain them. Before downgrading, restore the complete matching pre-upgrade save/state backup. Keeping old snapshots alone is not sufficient.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix
releases.body:
## G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

- Fix disk-write ownership checks that could prevent Course Edit saves from completing and cause track imports to fail with MFS error 244.
- Preserve snapshot validation, rollback, and recovery protections during save and import operations.
- Add regression coverage using the production disk-write helper, including write failures and rollback.

Back up your installation's save and course-state files before updating. This hotfix does not change the course snapshot format.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.1 - The Small Improvements and Fixes Update
releases.body:
## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and `course-elements.gdxs`, `course-forks.gbs`, and
`course-settings.gks` together. Do not open snapshot-backed saves in an older executable.
The new, extended tracks that go above the original 64 node limit are not compatible with the original Expansion Kit or older tools.

## Course Edit

- Widen the native course information panel at a fixed size. Keep full 20-character names on
  one row and fit three-digit node counts without moving the buttons below it. Dynamic sizing
  is deferred.

- Raise the combined main-path and alternate-path control-point ceiling to **127**. Geometry,
  jump, effect, decoration, and junction budgets still apply; 127 points is not a guarantee
  that every layout fits.
- Add complete, content-bound save snapshots for extended courses and complete course/cup
  package sharing. Missing or mismatched required snapshot data is rejected rather than
  silently loading a truncated course.
- Keep both paths selectable after editor reload and save/reload. Show stored branch nodes

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.0 - The Big Upgrade Edition
releases.body:
1.2.0 brings G-Diffuser to macOS and Android, adds an in-game updater, and is the biggest Course Edit update so far: Mouse Controls, undo, forks, lava strips from F-Zero GX, Magnet strips for the original F-Zero, and Blender-style camera controls. Thanks to everyone in the feature requests channel who shaped it.

## Before you update

- **Coming from 1.1.0, download this release by hand.** 1.1.0 has no updater. From 1.2 on, desktop builds can update themselves.
- **To install by hand,** extract the release over your existing `G-Diffuser` folder. Your `saves/`, ROM and game data stay where they are.
- **Rebuild your ROM hack archives.** Hacks now carry more of their own data, and an archive built by an older version doesn't have it.
- **Continue Cup is per hack.** An existing `gp_resume.bin` stays with the stock game, and each hack starts with no saved cup.
- **Courses that use new features need 1.2.** Forks, magnet traps, custom music and custom elements are ignored or lost on older versions.
